crossRefs.note: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.
“Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see…
Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. Yahweh showed him…

people.name: Diblathaim
people.line: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings.

people.name: Nebo
people.line: A city and mountain in Moab

people.name: Nebo_Mount
people.line: The mountain where Moses viewed the Promised Land

translations.web: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
translations.bsb: They set out from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim facing Nebo.
translations.kjv: And they removed from Almondiblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from Almon-diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
